# Source binding method

The recovered producer files under `source/` are immutable and authenticated by
the outer package manifest. At runtime, the launcher creates separate execution
packages under the private Wave 2B2A state.

Binding is deliberately narrow:

1. Module-level paths, hashes, and sample counts are changed through an
   AST-checked constant binder.
2. Six exact, one-occurrence C7X substitutions convert former-sample equality
   gates into recorded diagnostics and update the claim-boundary label.
3. Two exact, one-occurrence C7R substitutions select the completed Wave 2B1
   history run and bind the newly observed C7X switcher counts.
4. When C7X passes its frozen support gate, the C7R numerical reproduction gate
   is bound to the C7X result created in the same execution.
5. When C7X retains its primary as not estimable, two additional exact,
   one-occurrence substitutions mark the reproduction gate not applicable and
   allow C7R's independent first/repeat family and frozen all-attempts
   relationship diagnostics to proceed. Every relationship attempt carries the
   parent failed-support label.

Every change is syntax checked and written to a source-binding receipt with
original/generated hashes. Estimating equations, covariates, fixed effects,
cluster definitions, model inventory, and minimum-support rules are unchanged.
The amendment changes only outer failure handling after an expected, retained
low-support disposition.
